name: Goran D. Kleut
bio: Goran D. Kleut was born on November 4, 1975 in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia. Goran D. is an actor and editor, known for Hacksaw Ridge (2016), Alien: Covenant (2017) and Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Men Tell No Tales (2017).
